mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code AS roleCode, r.data_scope AS dataScope, r.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, rp.id AS rolePolicyId, rp.status AS rolePolicyStatus FROM sys_role_policy rp INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = r.tenant_id AND t.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' WHERE rp.target_type = 'USER' AND rp.target_id = #{userPolicyId} AND rp.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' AND rp.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT r.role_code AS roleCode, r.data_scope AS dataScope, r.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, rp.id AS rolePolicyId, rp.status AS rolePolicyStatus FROM sys_user_policy up INNER JOIN sys_role_policy rp ON rp.target_type = 'USER' AND rp.target_id = up.id AND rp.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id AND r.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = up.target_id AND t.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND up.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED'
